title: The Whole City Listened
old_p1: Jonah had run away once, but Heavenly Father gave him another chance. He spoke to Jonah a second time. “Go to Nineveh,” He said. And this time, Jonah went.
Nineveh was so big it took three days to walk across it. Jonah called out, “In forty days, Nineveh will be broken down.” The people believed Heavenly Father.
old_p2: The people decided to stop doing wrong things. They went without food and wore sackcloth, a rough, scratchy cloth people wore to show they were sorry.
Even the king came down from his throne and sat in ashes. Heavenly Father saw them change, and He kept their city safe.
Heavenly Father always watches for a heart that turns back to Him. Tonight, feel how good it is to get another chance.
p1: Heavenly Father spoke to Jonah a second time. “Go to Nineveh,” He said. This time, Jonah went!
Nineveh was so big, it took three days to walk across it. Jonah called out, “In forty days, Nineveh will be broken down!”
The people believed Heavenly Father. They stopped doing wrong things. They stopped eating for a while. They wore sackcloth, a scratchy cloth that showed they were sorry.
p2: Even the king got down from his throne. He took off his fancy robe and sat in ashes. Back then, people sat in ashes to show they were sad and sorry. Heavenly Father saw them change, so He kept their city safe.
Heavenly Father gave Jonah and Nineveh a second chance. He gives you second chances too. Tonight you can thank Him for letting you try again.
